_howto: Employee Costs tours. steps = page tour. sections = one tour per screen plus the component form tour. Guides in employeecosts_guides.json.
title: Employee Costs tour
whatsNewText: We've added something new here since you last took the tour.

steps.title: Welcome to Employee Costs
steps.text:
Turn the hours from Time & Attendance into costs, wages, payroll files, wage advice slips and bank files.

Use Next and Back, or your arrow keys. Press Esc to close.

steps.title: All screens
steps.text: Set up in this order: Settings, Cost Components, then Employee Allocation. Then the other screens produce the files each pay run.

steps.title: Overview
steps.text: How many employees are costed, and your active earnings, deductions and company contributions.

steps.title: Cost Components
steps.text: The building blocks: allowances, bonuses and deductions, and company contributions such as UIF or medical aid.

steps.title: Employee Allocation
steps.text: Which components each employee gets, with their amounts, one by one or in bulk.

steps.title: Monthly Wage Calc
steps.text: Work out wages for a date range from the hours worked in Time & Attendance and each person's components.

steps.title: Payfiles & Export
steps.text: The file for your payroll system, laid out the way it expects (CSV or Excel).

steps.title: Wage Advice
steps.text: A wage advice slip per person, as Excel or PDF, or saved to their self-service profile.

steps.title: Bank Files
steps.text: A payment file for your bank, in CSV or TXT.

steps.title: Settings
steps.text: Weekly overtime, what's shown, and your own wage advice template.

steps.title: Make more room
steps.text: Collapse the menu to icons only, and click again to open it.

steps.title: Search any screen
steps.text: Jump straight to any screen you have access to, in any module.

steps.title: Your menu
steps.text: Your profile, other areas of the system, Dark Mode and logout.

steps.title: Help & Tours
steps.text: Opens the same help menu as the ? button.

steps.title: Help is always here
steps.text: Click ? for this tour, a tour of the screen you're on, and how-to guides.

steps.title: You're all set
steps.text: Each screen also has its own short tour. It starts the first time you open that screen, and you can replay it any time from ?.

steps.title: Add Component
steps.text: An earning, a deduction or a company contribution: a fixed amount, a percentage, or a figure typed in each time.

steps.title: Your components
steps.text: Edit or remove one. Removing it stops it being offered; people who have it keep their history.

steps.title: Find people
steps.text: Search, or filter by department.

steps.title: Each person's costs
steps.text: Click a person to set their overhead and which earnings, deductions and contributions they get, with the amounts.

steps.title: Bulk Allocate
steps.text: Tick people and give them the same components in one go.

steps.title: Export
steps.text: All allocations to Excel, to check or to fill in and upload.

steps.title: Date range
steps.text: The period to calculate.

steps.title: Add Employees
steps.text: Choose who to calculate. Their hours come from Time & Attendance; open a person to see their timesheet.

steps.title: The calculation
steps.text: Hours, rates, components and totals per person.

steps.title: Profiles
steps.text: A profile is the layout your payroll system expects. Config sets the columns and their order.

steps.title: Who and when
steps.text: Dates, department and an employee group.

steps.title: Generate Preview
steps.text: Check the lines first, then export as CSV or Excel.

steps.title: Dates and people
steps.text: Choose the period and the employees.

steps.title: Generate Preview
steps.text: Hours as decimals or as time, then export to Excel or PDF.

steps.title: Save to ESS
steps.text: Puts each person's slip in their self-service Payslips.

steps.title: Bank details
steps.text: The employee field that holds the bank details, dates and people.

steps.title: Generate Preview
steps.text: Check the amounts, then export as CSV or TXT for your bank.

steps.title: Hours follow TNA
steps.text: On: every hour here is exactly what TNA Team View shows. Piece Work settings only change the pay, not the hours.

steps.title: Weekly overtime
steps.text: Only used when 'Hours follow TNA' is off: moves Normal Time over the weekly limit into Overtime.

steps.title: What's shown
steps.text: Whether terminated employees are listed, and what wage advice slips show.

steps.title: Your wage advice template
steps.text: Download the starter template and the tag dictionary, design your own slip in Excel, and upload it.

steps.title: Save Settings
steps.text: Saves these settings.
